nodes.label: sqlite3_exec
nodes.desc: One-shot helper: prepares each statement, steps it to completion. The connection itself is opened by sqlite3_open_v2 in main.c (L3768).

nodes.label: sqlite3_prepare_v2
nodes.desc: Compiles one SQL string into a VDBE program (sqlite3_prepare_v2, L972).

nodes.label: sqlite3RunParser
nodes.desc: Tokenizer: walks the SQL text, classifies tokens, and feeds the generated LALR parser (L600).

nodes.label: sqlite3Parser
nodes.desc: Lemon LALR(1) grammar (%name sqlite3Parser, L59); Lemon (tool/lemon.c) generates parse.c from it.

nodes.label: sqlite3StartTable
nodes.desc: DDL code generation: CREATE TABLE/INDEX actions (sqlite3StartTable L1292, sqlite3EndTable L2757).

nodes.label: sqlite3WhereBegin
nodes.desc: Query planner: picks indexes, orders join loops, emits the loop opcodes (L6954).

nodes.label: sqlite3VdbeExec
nodes.desc: Register-based virtual machine: the giant switch that executes every prepared statement (L903).

nodes.label: sqlite3BtreeBeginTrans
nodes.desc: B-tree storage engine: transactions (L3838), cursors, page balancing (sqlite3BtreeInsert L9445).

nodes.label: sqlite3PagerSharedLock
nodes.desc: Pager: locking (L5323), journaling, page cache persistence, commit phases.

nodes.label: sqlite3WalFrames
nodes.desc: Write-ahead log: appends frames to the -wal file (L4376), recovers the wal-index (walIndexRecover L1422).

nodes.label: sqlite3_malloc64
nodes.desc: Pluggable allocator core backing every subsystem (L322).

nodes.label: unixRead
nodes.desc: VFS: pluggable OS interface; unixRead L3512 / unixWrite L3643.
